Matrix multiplication is defined when the number of columns in the first matrix equals the number of rows in the second matrix. Here, matrix A is 2 × 7, and matrix B is 7 × 5. Since the number of columns in A (7) matches the number of rows in B (7), the product AB is defined.

The resulting matrix will have the number of rows of the first matrix and the number of columns of the second matrix. Therefore, the product matrix AB will have dimensions 2 × 5.

Answer: B
